speaker: Joseph Ayanda, natural speaking voice; one speaker only
recording_rule: One continuous recording. Speak naturally. Leave about 1.5-2 seconds between quoted utterances and about 3 seconds after a confirmation/discard. Do not deliberately imitate synthetic or American/British speech. No background music. Ordinary room noise is allowed.
evaluation_policy: No code or threshold change after first listening until this frozen run is scored. If it fails, preserve the failures, move them into development, make a new code revision, and require a new holdout recording before any new human-generalization claim.
safety_expectations: Rice twelve cartons never changes the earlier confirmed rice count.
Confirm twelve cannot rescue a wrong-unit rice draft.
Confirm thirteen cannot commit a pending beans count of thirty.
Discard count clears the unconfirmed beans-thirty draft without changing confirmed beans twenty-three.
Zero is accepted only after explicit quantity-echo confirmation.
secondary_metrics: finalized provider turn transcription versus scripted intent
time from end of each spoken turn to finalized provider turn when measurable
limitations: One scripted speaker/session is integration evidence, not population-level Nigerian-accent accuracy, shopkeeper usability, or calibrated ASR performance.
